selection_policy: Current primary language documentation, database documentation, and official project documentation for runtime stability, relational transaction semantics, local-first persistence, crash recovery, backups, driver integration and durable-execution applicability.

sources.title: Go 1.26 Release Notes
limitations: Does not evaluate Aurora-specific persistence or operational burden

sources.title: Go Release History
supports: Go 1.26 stable release line and support policy
limitations: Release status alone does not prove application suitability

sources.title: Accessing Relational Databases in Go
limitations: Actual database guarantees depend on selected engine and driver

sources.title: Executing Transactions in Go
limitations: Crash/power-loss durability is delegated to the database/driver/storage stack

sources.title: Rust 1.97.1 Release
limitations: Release status alone does not prove Aurora-specific fit

sources.title: The Rust Programming Language — Ownership
supports: compile-time memory safety without garbage collection
limitations: Memory safety does not by itself solve transactional, authority or restore correctness

sources.title: Rusqlite
limitations: Uses SQLite C binding; build/runtime behavior still needs Aurora-specific validation

sources.title: Appropriate Uses For SQLite
limitations: General guidance does not prove Aurora driver/configuration behavior

sources.title: SQLite PRAGMA synchronous
limitations: Depends on VFS/filesystem/storage honoring synchronization correctly

sources.title: SQLite Backup API
limitations: Aurora logical export still needs schema/integrity/authority semantics above raw backup

sources.title: How To Corrupt An SQLite Database File
supports: unsafe raw-copy and journal/WAL handling failure modes
limitations: Does not replace deliberate Aurora fault-injection testing

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 Reliability and WAL
limitations: Requires separate server administration and reliable storage configuration

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 Backup and Restore
supports: SQL dump, filesystem backup and continuous archiving options
limitations: Physical backup is not Aurora's portable logical sovereignty format

sources.title: RocksDB Overview
limitations: Low-level KV interface shifts relational/schema/invariant responsibility into Aurora

sources.title: modernc.org/sqlite
limitations: Documentation explicitly identifies a fragile exact-version dependency on modernc.org/libc; must be exercised by spike

sources.title: mattn/go-sqlite3
limitations: Requires CGO and a C toolchain; cross-build and distribution implications require measurement

sources.title: ncruces/go-sqlite3 Releases
supports: current Go SQLite alternative and release cadence
limitations: Project explicitly flags recent wasm2go transition as potentially less stable; not preferred for the first sovereignty store without additional evidence

sources.title: DBOS Go Programming Guide
limitations: Solves long-running workflow execution, a problem not currently required by M0

sources.title: Restate Key Concepts
limitations: Adds a distinct execution runtime/history that M0 does not currently require

sources.title: Mastra Temporal Workflows
supports: Temporal fit for workflows lasting hours/days or surviving worker restarts
limitations: Does not justify a durable workflow engine for M0's short internal state operations
